name: MultiMath-300K
description: MultiMath-300K is a novel, diverse, and comprehensive multimodal mathematical dataset spanning K-12 levels, containing image captions and step-wise solutions. It supports training and evaluation of multimodal large language models that integrate visual inputs with mathematical reasoning.
reputation: A recent multimodal math dataset that is useful for training and evaluating visual mathematical reasoning, but it is not yet a widely established standard benchmark.
notes: Dataset supports multimodal math reasoning with images and text; designed to bridge vision and math capabilities in LLMs.
